events.title: Annual Physical Exam
events.description: Routine yearly checkup. All vitals normal. Blood pressure: 120/80, Weight: 165 lbs, Height: 5'8"
events.notes: Doctor recommended continuing current exercise routine and diet.

events.title: Flu Shot
events.description: Annual influenza vaccination administered. No adverse reactions.
events.notes: Pharmacy visit. Next flu shot due: Fall 2024

events.title: Blood Work - Complete Panel
events.description: Comprehensive metabolic panel, lipid panel, and CBC. All results within normal range.
events.notes: Cholesterol: 185 mg/dL, Glucose: 92 mg/dL. No action needed.

events.title: Minor Knee Injury
events.description: Twisted knee during morning jog. Applied ice and compression. Mild swelling.
events.notes: RICE protocol followed. Pain subsided after 3 days.

events.title: Dental Cleaning
events.description: Six-month dental checkup and cleaning. No cavities detected.
events.notes: Dentist recommended flossing more regularly. Next visit: December 2024

events.title: Started Blood Pressure Medication
events.description: Began taking Lisinopril 10mg daily for mild hypertension.
events.notes: Prescription: Lisinopril 10mg, once daily in morning. Monitor BP at home weekly.

events.title: Cardiology Consultation
events.description: Follow-up appointment with cardiologist regarding hypertension management. EKG performed - normal results.
events.notes: Continue current medication. Return in 3 months for follow-up.

events.title: Vision Exam
events.description: Annual eye exam. Slight change in prescription for nearsightedness.
events.notes: New prescription: -2.25 OD, -2.50 OS. Ordered new glasses.

events.title: Cold/Upper Respiratory Infection
events.description: Developed sore throat, runny nose, and mild cough. Rest and fluids.
events.notes: Symptoms lasted 5 days. No antibiotics needed. Over-the-counter cold medicine used.

events.title: Cardiology Follow-up
events.description: Three-month follow-up for hypertension. BP readings excellent: 118/76.
events.notes: Medication working well. Continue current dosage. Next visit: February 2025

events.title: Dermatology Screening
events.description: Full body skin check for abnormal moles or lesions. All clear.
events.notes: No concerning findings. Reminder to use sunscreen daily. Next screening: December 2025

events.title: Physical Therapy - Initial Evaluation
events.description: Started PT for chronic lower back pain. Assessment completed, treatment plan developed.
events.notes: Plan: 2x weekly sessions for 6 weeks. Focus on core strengthening and flexibility.
